decisions.reason: The mechanical size, aspect ratio, and mounting-hole specifications do not change the J_BAT NTC interface.
The board-layout decision does not change any battery-protection mode, cutoff, or safety requirement.
The mechanical constraints do not alter the battery NTC temperature-sensing method.
Board dimensions, shape, and mounting holes do not change the boost converter enable control or its powered loads.
The source decision does not modify or remove the required TVS-based ESD protection.
USB-C placement on the shorter board edge is owned by the mechanical-layout Requirement and does not change the connector type, data-line, or sourceability requirements.
The power-board mechanical layout does not change the I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
Making the board as small as its components permit does not itself alter the established component-availability or fallback-selection rules.
